items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Now he tried to teach me once, but it didn't help much.

ctx.x: Yes, and he met a girl whom he married, and she had a higher design for him in the business world, so he went to Boston University, never played again except for his own amusement -- and after that beautiful background as a drummer, and he became an insurance executive and came back to my home town. Now he tried to teach me once, but it didn't help much. You know how it's very hard to teach your own family?
